stimuli.title: Seven people live on different floors of a seven-storey building. Floor 1 is the bottom floor, and floor 7 is the top floor.
stimuli.body:
Clues:
1. Bharat is exactly 3 positions above Chitra.
2. Charu is at floor 1.
3. In the stated ordering, Pooja comes before Zara, and Zara comes before Sana.
4. Pooja is exactly 2 positions above Isha.
stimuli.solution: floor 1: Charu; floor 2: Isha; floor 3: Chitra; floor 4: Pooja; floor 5: Zara; floor 6: Bharat; floor 7: Sana

stimuli.title: Seven people have interviews in seven consecutive months from January to July, one per month.

stimuli.title: Seven employees hold seven distinct ranks (rank 1 is junior-most and rank 7 is senior-most).

stimuli.title: In a certain coded language, each word has one unique code.
stimuli.body:
velvet thunder yellow = ka ju di
forest almond thunder = no li ka
forest inland yellow = di ro no
almond inland velvet = ro ju li
stimuli.solution: thunder=ka, yellow=di, velvet=ju, forest=no, almond=li, inland=ro

questions.stem: Given the inequality chain P ≥ Q = R ≥ X ≥ U, decide which conclusions follow. I: Q > U. II: Q ≤ R.
options: Both conclusions I and II follow
Either conclusion I or II follows
questions.explanation: Exhaustive valid-order checking confirms: I is not necessarily true and II is always true.

questions.stem: Ritu walks 55 km north, then 44 km east, then 11 km south and finally 11 km west. What is her shortest distance from the starting point?
questions.explanation: Net north = 44 km and east = 33 km. Distance = √(44²+33²) = 55 km.

questions.stem: Kiran moves 11 km north, 66 km east, 33 km south and 11 km west. In which direction is Kiran from the start?

questions.stem: A cyclist travels 99 km north, 44 km east, 55 km south and 11 km west. What total distance did the cyclist travel?
questions.explanation: Total path length = 99+44+55+11=209 km (not displacement).
